We're kicking off a SIG/CAIQ review for our contract with Redwood and need to schedule a 60-minute intake call to go through the questionnaire and agree on an audit window for tenant-level log sampling. High-level asks:

- Walk through the attached NyxCloud SLA & questionnaire (attached).
- Clarify what tenant-scoped artifacts you can provide (redacted logs, access logs, config snapshots).

- Wed 11/11 09:00–10:00 PT

Best,

Hi Maya / Vanessa —

David here (security engineering). Quick orientation on what we can prepare for a tenant-scoped log sampling and evidence handoff:

Artifacts we can provide (tenant-scoped, redacted where appropriate):
- Application access logs (token/ID hashes redacted)
- API request traces (time-windowed sample)
- Audit trail for role changes and ACLs
- Configuration exports for tenant-specific routing and network settings

Retention notes: our hosted default is 90 days for production logs. For customers on Dedicated or with contract addenda we can extend retention or provide tail logs for a defined window — this typically requires a short SOW amendment.

Secure transfer options:
- Encrypted S3 presigned URL (preferred)
- Encrypted Drive share with restricted view/download

I'll attach a short instructions PDF with the recommended log sampling window and obfuscation checklist. For the intake call I can share a sanitized sample (10–20 requests) so your audit team can confirm format.

Action items before the call:
1) Confirm the exact tenant ID(s) you want sampled.
2) Tell us the sampling window (e.g., 2026-10-20 to 2026-10-27).
3) Confirm whether you need hashes/pseudonyms preserved or fully redacted.

Thanks — looking forward to the call.

David Kim
Security Engineer | Redwood Inference
david.kim@redwood.com
Attachment: logs_sample_instructions.pdf
From: Maya Reddy <maya.reddy@nyxcloud.com>

Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 12:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: SIG review & tenant audit window

Thanks — Thu 11/12 10:00–11:00 PT works for us. Please send the calendar invite.

A couple quick clarifications ahead of the call so we can prep the audit team: 
- Retention: NyxCloud needs confirmation whether logs are encrypted at rest and whether Redwood supports customer-managed KMS or HSM for Dedicated instances.
- Tenant IDs: we will send two tenant IDs (prod and staging) via a secure channel prior to the call.
- Evidence format: the audit team prefers either CSV or JSON line format for request traces.

Attaching Carlos (security operations) who will be on the call. Can you confirm the expected artifacts we will see in our sample (exact filenames / schema)? Also please share any NDA/transfer constraints if you prefer S3 presigned links.

Thanks,
Maya Reddy
Security Program Manager
NyxCloud
Attachment: none
